step.cmd: Download the HP Click Driver from the official HP website.

info.p: Ensure that you select the correct driver version compatible with your operating system.

step.cmd: Open the downloaded file to begin the installation process.

info.p: If prompted by your operating system, allow the installation to proceed.

step.cmd: Follow the on-screen instructions to complete the installation.

info.p: During installation, you may be asked to configure network settings. Refer to the network configuration section below for guidance.
Access the printer network configuration settings through the front panel by navigating to Network > Gigabit Ethernet > Modify Configuration.
Ensure that the correct network protocols are enabled or disabled to optimize network traffic and security.

step.cmd: Restart your computer and printer to finalize the installation.

info.p: After restarting, verify that the HP Click Driver is functioning correctly by printing a test page.

note.p: Ensure that your printer is connected to the network and powered on before starting the installation process.
Disabling unused network protocols can reduce unnecessary network traffic and enhance security. Refer to the HP Jetdirect Print Server Administrator’s Guide for detailed instructions.
